labels: A single rounded hair coil sits at the nape, with surrounding strands gathered into its base and a few loose ends beside the neck.; 둥글게 감긴 머리 묶음 하나가 목덜미에 놓이고 주변 가닥이 그 밑동으로 모이며 짧은 잔가닥이 목 옆에 남는다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A single rounded hair coil sits at the nape, with surrounding strands gathered into its base and a few loose ends beside the neck.
aliases: 낮은 시뇽과 번
